Quoting @MariaVamvalis 
“I come at this work trying to root in the body and learning about the natural laws, but (also) citizenship as a framework as well. 
Through these (#climatechange) inquiries students had a lot of grief. I did my best to hold that grief, it’s my belief…

“I will mark my heart with an ‘X’ made of ash that says, the power to restore life resides here.”
💔😭 #ClimateEmergency #grief

Thank you, @jessewente for your clear sight to why change must come, and why it must involve us including ALL our flora and fauna neighbours. #ClimateChange #ClimateJustice #racialjustice #pandemicshift
